title: Fikr bildirish va uni asoslash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida istalgan mavzuda fikr bildirasiz, sabab va misol bilan asoslaysiz, odob bilan rozi bo‘lasiz yoki rad etasiz va firstly, moreover, however, in conclusion kabi so‘zlar bilan bir daqiqalik nutq tuzasiz.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirish: xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum, xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda nisbiy ergash gaplarni o‘rgandik: who, which, that bilan gapni boyitish. Bugun nutqning eng kerakli ko‘nikmalaridan biri: fikr bildirish va uni asoslash. Dars oxirida har qanday mavzuda o‘z fikringizni aytasiz, sabab va misol keltirasiz, boshqa odam bilan odob bilan rozi bo‘lasiz yoki bahslashasiz. Va bir daqiqalik chiqish tayyorlaysiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we are learning how to give an opinion and explain why. By the end, you will be able to speak clearly and politely for a full minute.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun fikr bildirishni va sababini tushuntirishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida bir daqiqa aniq va xushmuomala gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Fikr bildiruvchi iboralar

examples.t: I think English is useful for work.
examples.uz: Menimcha, ingliz tili ish uchun foydali.

examples.t: In my opinion, learning online is convenient.

scenes.say_native: Fikrni boshlash uchun eng oddiy ibora: “I think”. Undan keyin “that” ni tushirib qoldirsa bo‘ladi. Rasmiyroq ibora: “In my opinion” va “I believe”. “I feel that” ko‘proq his-tuyg‘uga asoslangan fikrda ishlatiladi. O‘zbekchada “menimcha”, “fikrimcha” desak yetadi, inglizchada esa ibora gapning boshida to‘liq shaklda turadi va undan keyin oddiy gap keladi: “I think English is useful”.
scenes.say: The simplest phrase is I think. A bit more formal: in my opinion, or I believe. I think English is useful for work. In my opinion, learning online is convenient.
scenes.say_uz: Eng oddiy ibora: I think. Biroz rasmiyroq: in my opinion yoki I believe. Menimcha, ingliz tili ish uchun foydali. Fikrimcha, onlayn o‘qish qulay.

scenes.title: Yana ibora: yumshoq va kuchli
board: I tend to think… / I'm not sure, but… (yumshoq)

examples.t: I'm convinced that exercise improves mood.
I tend to think that cities are noisy.

scenes.say_native: Fikrning kuchi har xil bo‘lishi mumkin. Kuchli ishonch uchun: “I’m convinced that”, “I’m sure that”. Yumshoq, ehtiyotkor fikr uchun: “I tend to think”, “I’m not sure, but I think”. Yana ikkita foydali ibora: “From my point of view” va “As far as I’m concerned”, ya’ni “menga kelsak”. Qat’iy aytish kerak bo‘lsagina kuchli shaklni tanlang.
scenes.say: For a strong opinion: I'm convinced that exercise improves mood. For a softer opinion: I tend to think that cities are noisy. Or: I'm not sure, but I think so.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli fikr uchun: ishonchim komilki, mashq kayfiyatni yaxshilaydi. Yumshoqroq fikr uchun: shaharlar shovqinli, deb o‘ylashga moyilman. Yoki: ishonchim komil emas, lekin shunday deb o‘ylayman.

scenes.title: Boshqalarning fikrini so‘rash

examples.t: What do you think about working from home?
examples.uz: Uydan ishlash haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz?

examples.t: Do you agree with me?

scenes.say_native: Suhbat bir tomonlama bo‘lmasligi kerak, shuning uchun boshqalardan ham fikr so‘rang. “What do you think about” dan keyin ot yoki fe’lning -ing shakli keladi: “What do you think about working from home?”. Yana: “What’s your opinion on” va “How do you feel about”. “Do you agree?” esa qisqa va qulay. Diqqat: “think about” dan keyin “-ing”, chunki predlogdan keyin fe’l shu shaklda turadi.
scenes.say: What do you think about working from home? What's your opinion on this? How do you feel about it? Do you agree with me?
scenes.say_uz: Uydan ishlash haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz? Bu haqda fikringiz qanday? Bunga qanday qaraysiz? Menga qo‘shilasizmi?

scenes.title: Fikrdagi tipik xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato bor. Birinchisi: “I am agree”. O‘zbekcha “men roziman” deymiz, shuning uchun “am” qo‘shamiz, ammo “agree” o‘zi fe’l: “I agree”. Ikkinchisi: “In my opinion, I think” kabi ikkita iborani ketma-ket qo‘yish. Bittasi yetadi. Uchinchisi: “I am thinking” bilan fikr aytish. Fikr uchun oddiy hozirgi zamon: “I think”. “I’m thinking” faqat o‘ylash jarayonini bildiradi.
scenes.say: Don't say I am agree. Say I agree. Use one opinion phrase, not two. And use I think, not I am thinking, when you give an opinion.
scenes.say_uz: I am agree demang. I agree deng. Bitta fikr iborasini ishlating, ikkita emas. Fikr aytganda I am thinking emas, I think deng.

scenes.title: Iborani to‘g‘rilang
board: 2) In my opinion I think it is good.
3) I am thinking it is expensive.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato gapni to‘g‘rilang. Birinchi: “I am agree with you”. Ikkinchi: “In my opinion I think it is good”. Uchinchi: “I am thinking it is expensive”. Har birini baland ovozda to‘g‘ri shaklda ayting. Esingizda bo‘lsin: bitta ibora, to‘g‘ri zamon va “agree” oldidan “am” yo‘q.
scenes.say: One: I am agree with you. Two: In my opinion I think it is good. Three: I am thinking it is expensive. Correct each sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: I am agree with you. Ikkinchi: In my opinion I think it is good. Uchinchi: I am thinking it is expensive. Har birini to‘g‘rilang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) In my opinion, it is good. / I think it is good.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “I agree with you”. Ikkinchi, “In my opinion, it is good” yoki “I think it is good”, bittasini tanlaysiz. Uchinchi, “I think it is expensive”. Hozirgi oddiy zamon, chunki biz fikr bildiryapmiz, jarayon emas. Agar uchalasini ham to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, ofarin. Yo‘q bo‘lsa, keyingi misollarda shu iboralarni yana ko‘p eshitasiz.
scenes.say: One: I agree with you. Two: In my opinion, it is good. Three: I think it is expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Men sizga qo‘shilaman. Ikkinchi: Fikrimcha, bu yaxshi. Uchinchi: Menimcha, bu qimmat.

scenes.title: Sabab: because, since, as

examples.t: I like trains because they are cheap.
As it's cold, I prefer to stay in.
examples.uz: Sovuq bo‘lgani uchun uyda qolishni afzal ko‘raman.

examples.t: We stayed home because of the rain.

scenes.say_native: Fikrni asoslash uchun sabab kerak. Eng oddiy bog‘lovchi: “because”. Undan keyin to‘liq gap keladi: ega va fe’l. “Since” va “as” ham sabab bildiradi, odatda sabab suhbatdoshga ma’lum bo‘lganda va gap boshida ishlatiladi. Ot bilan esa “because of” qo‘llanadi: “because of the rain”. O‘zbekchada “chunki” yoki “-gani uchun” desak yetadi, ingliz tilida esa bu ikki xil: gap bilan “because”, ot bilan “because of”.
scenes.say: Use because with a full clause. I like trains because they are cheap. Since and as can start a sentence. As it's cold, I prefer to stay in. With a noun, use because of: because of the rain.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq gap bilan because ishlating. Poyezdlarni yoqtiraman, chunki ular arzon. Since va as gapni boshlashi mumkin. Sovuq bo‘lgani uchun uyda qolishni afzal ko‘raman. Ot bilan because of: yomg‘ir tufayli.

scenes.title: Misol keltirish

examples.t: Social media is useful. For example, I can contact friends abroad.
examples.uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq foydali. Masalan, chet eldagi do‘stlarim bilan bog‘lana olaman.

examples.t: I enjoy sports such as football and swimming.
examples.uz: Futbol va suzish kabi sportlarni yoqtiraman.

scenes.say_native: Fikr aniq bo‘lishi uchun misol kerak. “For example” yoki “for instance” alohida gap boshida turadi va ortidan vergul qo‘yiladi. Gap ichida esa “such as” ishlatamiz, ortidan ot keladi: “sports such as football”. Misol ko‘pincha sizning shaxsiy tajribangiz bo‘ladi. Masalan, “Last year I learned to cook from videos”. Bunday aniq misol tinglovchini ishontiradi.
scenes.say: A good opinion needs an example. Social media is useful. For example, I can contact friends abroad. I enjoy sports such as football and swimming.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi fikrga misol kerak. Ijtimoiy tarmoq foydali. Masalan, chet eldagi do‘stlarim bilan bog‘lana olaman. Men futbol va suzish kabi sportlarni yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: Qisqa struktura: fikr, sabab, misol

examples.t: I think online lessons are great because they save time. For example, I don't need to travel.
examples.uz: Menimcha, onlayn darslar zo‘r, chunki vaqtni tejaydi. Masalan, qatnash shart emas.

scenes.say_native: Har bir fikr uchun oddiy uch qadamli reja ishlating. Birinchi: fikringiz. Ikkinchi: sabab, “because” bilan. Uchinchi: misol, “for example” bilan. Xohlasangiz, to‘rtinchi qadam: fikrni qisqacha takrorlash. Masalan: “I think online lessons are great because they save time. For example, I don’t need to travel to school.” Ana shunday reja bilan bir daqiqa nutq osongina to‘ladi, chunki har fikrga 15 soniya ketadi.
scenes.say: Use a simple plan: opinion, reason, example. I think online lessons are great because they save time. For example, I don't need to travel to school.
scenes.say_uz: Oddiy reja ishlating: fikr, sabab, misol. Menimcha, onlayn darslar zo‘r, chunki vaqtni tejaydi. Masalan, maktabga qatnashim shart emas.

scenes.title: Sabab va misolda xatolar
board: ✗ I like it because is cheap.
✓ I like it because it is cheap.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: “because” dan keyin egani tushirib qoldirish. O‘zbekchada ega ko‘pincha aytilmaydi, inglizchada esa har bir gapda ega shart: “because it is cheap”. Ikkinchi xato: “because of” dan keyin gap qo‘yish. “Because of” dan keyin faqat ot: “because of the price”. Uchinchi: “for example” dan keyin vergul qo‘ymaslik. Yozma nutqda bu muhim, og‘zakida esa shu yerda sal to‘xtang.
scenes.say: After because, use a full clause: because it is cheap. After because of, use a noun: because of the price. And put a comma after for example.
scenes.say_uz: Because dan keyin to‘liq gap: because it is cheap. Because of dan keyin ot: because of the price. For example dan keyin vergul qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Fikringizni asoslang
board: 1) Cities are better than villages. Why?
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz urinib ko‘ring. Mavzu: “shaharlar qishloqlardan yaxshimi?”. O‘z fikringizni ayting: “I think…”. Keyin “because” bilan bitta sabab keltiring, so‘ng “for example” bilan misol qo‘shing. Uch gap yetadi. Qaysi tomonni tanlasangiz ham mayli, asosiysi sabab va misol bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Do you think cities are better than villages? Give your opinion, one reason with because, and one example with for example.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar qishloqlardan yaxshi, deb o‘ylaysizmi? Fikringizni ayting, because bilan bitta sabab va for example bilan bitta misol keltiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I think cities are better because there are more jobs.
For example, my cousin found a job in Tashkent in a week.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: “I think cities are better because there are more jobs. For example, my cousin found a job in Tashkent in one week.” Qarshi fikr ham to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi: “I prefer villages because the air is clean. For example, we can grow our own fruit.” Sizning javobingizda uchta narsa bormi: fikr, sabab va misol? Agar bo‘lsa, siz bir daqiqalik nutq uchun asosni tayyorladingiz.
scenes.say: I think cities are better because there are more jobs. For example, my cousin found a job in Tashkent in one week. Or: I prefer villages because the air is clean.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, shaharlar yaxshiroq, chunki ish ko‘proq. Masalan, amakivachcham Toshkentda bir haftada ish topdi. Yoki: Men qishloqni afzal ko‘raman, chunki havo toza.

scenes.title: Dialog: maktab formasi
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki talaba maktab formasi haqida bahslashmoqda. Har biri qanday fikr aytganini va qanday sabab keltirganini toping. Ularning iboralariga ham e’tibor bering: kim “I think” deydi, kim “I’m not sure” deydi. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Mia: What do you think about school uniforms? Ben: I think they are a good idea because everyone looks equal. Mia: I see your point, but I'm not sure. For example, students can't show their personality. Ben: That's true, but uniforms also save money.
scenes.say_uz: Mia: Maktab formasi haqida nima deb o‘ylaysan? Ben: Menimcha, yaxshi fikr, chunki hamma teng ko‘rinadi. Mia: Fikringni tushundim, lekin ishonchim komil emas. Masalan, o‘quvchilar shaxsiyatini ko‘rsata olmaydi. Ben: To‘g‘ri, lekin forma pulni ham tejaydi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) What other reason does Ben give?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Ben nima uchun maktab formasini yoqtiradi? Ikkinchi: Miyaning misoli nima? Uchinchi: Ben yana qanday sabab keltiradi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Masalan, “Ben likes uniforms because…”. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni ichingizda eslab chiqing.
scenes.say: One: Why does Ben like uniforms? Two: What is Mia's example? Three: What other reason does Ben give?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Ben nima uchun formani yoqtiradi? Ikkinchi: Miyaning misoli nima? Uchinchi: Ben yana qanday sabab keltiradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, Ben formani yoqtiradi, chunki hamma teng ko‘rinadi. Ikkinchi, Miya misol sifatida o‘quvchilar shaxsiyatini ko‘rsata olmasligini aytdi. Uchinchi, Benning yana bir sababi: forma pulni tejaydi. E’tibor bering, ikkalasi ham fikrini sabab bilan qo‘llab-quvvatladi va bir-birining so‘zini bo‘lmadi.
scenes.say: One: Because everyone looks equal. Two: Students can't show their personality. Three: Uniforms save money.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Chunki hamma teng ko‘rinadi. Ikkinchi: O‘quvchilar shaxsiyatini ko‘rsata olmaydi. Uchinchi: Forma pulni tejaydi.

scenes.title: Rozilik bildirish
board: You're right. / I couldn't agree more.
So do I. / Neither do I.

examples.t: I couldn't agree more.
examples.uz: Bundan ortiq qo‘shila olmayman, ya’ni mutlaqo roziman.

examples.t: That's a good point.

scenes.say_native: Rozilikni turli kuchda bildirish mumkin. Oddiy: “I agree” va “You’re right”. Kuchli: “I totally agree”, “Exactly!” va “I couldn’t agree more”. Bu oxirgisi so‘zma-so‘z “bundan ortiq qo‘shila olmayman” degani, ya’ni mutlaqo roziman. Yana “That’s a good point” orqali suhbatdoshning fikrini maqtab ham qo‘yasiz.
scenes.say: I agree. I totally agree. You're right. I couldn't agree more. That's a good point.
scenes.say_uz: Roziman. Mutlaqo roziman. Haqsiz. Bundan ortiq qo‘shila olmayman. Bu yaxshi fikr.

scenes.title: Odob bilan rozi bo‘lmaslik
board: I see what you mean, but…
I'm not so sure about that.

examples.t: I'm afraid I don't agree.
I see what you mean, but I think it's too expensive.
examples.uz: Nima demoqchi ekaningizni tushundim, lekin menimcha, bu juda qimmat.

scenes.say_native: Rozi bo‘lmaslik ham odob bilan bo‘lishi kerak. “No, you’re wrong” juda qo‘pol eshitiladi. Yumshoq usul: avval suhbatdoshning fikrini tan oling, keyin “but” bilan o‘z fikringizni ayting: “I see what you mean, but…”. Yana “I’m afraid I don’t agree” yoki “I’m not so sure about that”. “I’m afraid” bu yerda qo‘rqish emas, balki yoqimsiz gapni yumshatish. O‘zbekchada ham “kechirasiz, lekin…” deymiz.
scenes.say: Say I see what you mean, but… Or: I'm afraid I don't agree. Or: I'm not so sure about that. Be polite and give a reason.
scenes.say_uz: I see what you mean, but… deng. Yoki: afsuski, qo‘shila olmayman. Yoki: bunga unchalik ishonmayman. Xushmuomala bo‘ling va sabab keltiring.

scenes.title: Qisman rozilik
board: I agree up to a point.

examples.t: You have a point, but it isn't the whole story.
examples.uz: Sizda haqiqat bor, lekin bu hammasi emas.

examples.t: I agree up to a point.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘pincha biz to‘liq rozi ham, to‘liq qarshi ham emasmiz. Shunda qisman rozilik iboralari kerak: “That’s partly true, but…”, “You have a point, but…” va “I agree up to a point”, ya’ni ma’lum darajada roziman. Bu iboralar o‘ylangan, madaniyatli suhbatdosh taassurotini beradi.
scenes.say: Sometimes we partly agree. That's partly true, but… You have a point, but it isn't the whole story. I agree up to a point.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zan qisman rozi bo‘lamiz. Bu qisman to‘g‘ri, lekin… Sizda haqiqat bor, lekin bu hammasi emas. Ma’lum darajada roziman.

scenes.title: Qo‘pol yoki noto‘g‘ri rad etish
board: ✗ I am not agree. ✓ I don't agree.
✓ I'm afraid I see it differently.
✓ I don't like noise. — Neither do I.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “I am not agree”. To‘g‘risi: “I don’t agree”, chunki “agree” fe’l. Ikkinchisi: “You are wrong!” deb to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytish. Bu suhbatni buzadi. Uning o‘rniga “I’m afraid I see it differently” deng. Yana bir nozik joy: “So do I” rozilik, ammo salbiy gapga “Neither do I” deyiladi. Masalan, “I don’t like noise.” “Neither do I”.
scenes.say: Say I don't agree, not I am not agree. Don't say you are wrong. Say: I'm afraid I see it differently. After a negative, say neither do I.
scenes.say_uz: I am not agree demang, I don't agree deng. You are wrong demang. Ayting: afsuski, men boshqacha qarayman. Inkordan keyin neither do I deng.

scenes.title: Mos javob tanlang
board: 1) Cars should be banned in the city centre.  (you agree strongly)
3) Fast food is healthy.  (you disagree politely)
scenes.say_native: Uchta fikr berilgan, har biriga turlicha javob bering. Birinchi: markazda mashinalarni taqiqlash kerak, siz kuchli qo‘shilasiz. Ikkinchi: uy vazifasi foydasiz, siz qisman qo‘shilasiz. Uchinchi: fast food foydali, siz odob bilan rad etasiz. Har safar qisqa sabab ham qo‘shing. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: Cars should be banned in the city centre. Agree strongly. Two: Homework is useless. Partly agree. Three: Fast food is healthy. Disagree politely.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Shahar markazida mashinalar taqiqlanishi kerak. Qattiq rozi bo‘ling. Ikkinchi: Uy vazifasi foydasiz. Qisman rozi bo‘ling. Uchinchi: Fast food foydali. Odob bilan rad eting.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) I couldn't agree more. The air is cleaner.
2) I agree up to a point, but it helps us practise.
3) I'm afraid I don't agree. It has too much fat.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “I couldn’t agree more. The air would be cleaner.” Ikkinchi: “I agree up to a point, but homework helps us practise.” Uchinchi: “I’m afraid I don’t agree. Fast food has too much fat and salt.” Sizning javoblaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, bu normal. Muhim jihat: ibora to‘g‘ri kuchda tanlangan va unga sabab ulangan.
scenes.say: One: I couldn't agree more. The air would be cleaner. Two: I agree up to a point, but homework helps us practise. Three: I'm afraid I don't agree. Fast food has too much fat and salt.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Bundan ortiq qo‘shila olmayman. Havo toza bo‘lardi. Ikkinchi: Ma’lum darajada roziman, lekin uy vazifasi mashq qilishga yordam beradi. Uchinchi: Afsuski, qo‘shila olmayman. Fast foodda yog‘ va tuz juda ko‘p.

scenes.title: Ketma-ketlik: firstly, secondly, finally
board: To begin with, … / First of all, …

examples.t: Firstly, it saves time. Secondly, it saves money.
examples.uz: Birinchidan, vaqtni tejaydi. Ikkinchidan, pulni tejaydi.

examples.t: Finally, it is good for the environment.
examples.uz: Va nihoyat, u tabiat uchun foydali.

scenes.say_native: Bir nechta sabab aytganda ularni tartib bilan joylashtiring. “Firstly”, “secondly”, “finally” o‘zbekchadagi “birinchidan, ikkinchidan, va nihoyat” ga mos. Ularga muqobil: “First of all”, “To begin with”, “Lastly”. Har biridan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Uch sabab yetarli.
scenes.say: Put your reasons in order. Firstly, it saves time. Secondly, it saves money. Finally, it is good for the environment.
scenes.say_uz: Sabablarni tartib bilan ayting. Birinchidan, vaqtni tejaydi. Ikkinchidan, pulni tejaydi. Va nihoyat, tabiat uchun foydali.

scenes.title: Qo‘shimcha fikr: moreover, in addition

examples.t: Moreover, it is easy to use.
In addition, it is free.
What's more, everyone has it.

scenes.say_native: Fikringizga yana bir dalil qo‘shish uchun “moreover”, “in addition” yoki “besides” ishlatamiz. “Moreover” yozma va rasmiyroq nutqqa mos. Ular o‘zbekchadagi “bundan tashqari”, “shuningdek” ga yaqin. Muhim narsa: bu so‘zlar oldingi fikr bilan bir yo‘nalishda ishlaydi, ya’ni yana bir dalil qo‘shadi. Qarama-qarshilik uchun esa boshqa so‘zlar kerak.
scenes.say: To add another point, use moreover, in addition, or besides. Moreover, it is easy to use. In addition, it is free. What's more, everyone has it.
scenes.say_uz: Yana bir dalil qo‘shish uchun moreover, in addition yoki besides ishlating. Bundan tashqari, undan foydalanish oson. Qo‘shimcha ravishda, u bepul. Yana shuki, uni hamma ishlatadi.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik: however, although

examples.t: It is cheap. However, it isn't very strong.
examples.uz: U arzon. Biroq u unchalik mustahkam emas.

examples.t: Although it is old, I love my phone.
On the other hand, it takes time.

scenes.say_native: Qarama-qarshi fikr uchun “however” va “on the other hand”. “However” odatda yangi gapni boshlaydi, oldidan nuqta, ortidan vergul keladi: “It is cheap. However, it isn’t strong.” “Although” esa gap ichida ishlaydi va ortidan to‘liq gap keladi: “Although it is old, I love it”. Muhim: “although” va “but” bir gapda birga ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: For contrast, use however or on the other hand. It is cheap. However, it isn't very strong. Although it is old, I love my phone.
scenes.say_uz: Qarama-qarshilik uchun however yoki on the other hand ishlating. U arzon. Biroq u unchalik mustahkam emas. Eski bo‘lsa-da, telefonimni yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Xulosa: in conclusion

examples.t: In conclusion, I believe online learning is worth trying.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, onlayn o‘qish sinab ko‘rishga arziydi.

examples.t: To sum up, it has more advantages than disadvantages.

scenes.say_native: Nutqni tugatish uchun xulosa iborasi kerak: “In conclusion”, “To sum up” yoki og‘zaki “All in all”. Yangi dalil qo‘shmaysiz, chunki bu tinglovchini adashtiradi. “That’s why I believe” iborasi ham ancha tabiiy. Yaxshi xulosa nutqingizga tugallangan ko‘rinish beradi.
scenes.say: End with a conclusion. In conclusion, I believe online learning is worth trying. To sum up, it has more advantages than disadvantages.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa bilan tugating. Xulosa qilib aytganda, onlayn o‘qish sinab ko‘rishga arziydi. Qisqasi, uning afzalliklari kamchiliklaridan ko‘p.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchilardagi xatolar
board: ✗ Although it is old, but I like it.
✓ Although it is old, I like it.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “but however” deb ikkala qarama-qarshilik so‘zini yonma-yon qo‘yish. Bittasi yetadi. Ikkinchisi: “Although it is old, but I like it”. O‘zbekchada “eski bo‘lsa-da, lekin yoqadi” deyish mumkin, inglizchada esa “although” bilan “but” birga kelmaydi. Uchinchisi: “however” dan oldin vergul bilan gapni davom ettirish. “It’s cheap, however it’s weak” noto‘g‘ri; nuqta yoki nuqtali vergul kerak.
scenes.say: Don't say but however. Use one. Don't say although, but. Use one. And start a new sentence before however: It is cheap. However, it is weak.
scenes.say_uz: But however demang, bittasini ishlating. Although va but birga kelmaydi. However dan oldin yangi gap boshlang: U arzon. Biroq u zaif.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchini tanlang
board: 1) The film was long. ___, it was great. (however / because)
2) ___ I was tired, I went out. (Although / However)
3) ___, it saves time. ___, it saves money. (Firstly / Secondly)
scenes.say_native: Uchta bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring. Birinchi: film uzun edi, ___ , u zo‘r edi. Ikkinchi: ___ charchagan bo‘lsam ham, tashqariga chiqdim. Uchinchi: ikkita sabab uchun tartib so‘zlarini qo‘ying. Har bir qaror uchun nega shunday tanlaganingizni o‘ylab ko‘ring. Javoblarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: The film was long. Blank, it was great. However or because? Two: Blank I was tired, I went out. Although or however? Three: Firstly and secondly.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Film uzun edi. ___ u zo‘r edi. However yoki because? Ikkinchi: ___ charchagan bo‘lsam ham, chiqdim. Although yoki however? Uchinchi: Firstly va secondly.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, “However”, chunki film uzun, lekin zo‘r, bu qarama-qarshilik. “Because” ma’noga mos emas. Ikkinchi, “Although I was tired, I went out”. “Although” gap boshida va to‘liq gap bilan. Uchinchi, “Firstly, it saves time. Secondly, it saves money”. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, qoida oddiy: “however” yangi gap boshida, “although” gap ichida bog‘laydi.
scenes.say: One: However. Two: Although I was tired, I went out. Three: Firstly, it saves time. Secondly, it saves money.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: However. Ikkinchi: Charchagan bo‘lsam ham, tashqariga chiqdim. Uchinchi: Birinchidan, vaqtni tejaydi. Ikkinchidan, pulni tejaydi.

scenes.title: Dialog: uydan ishlash
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki hamkasb uydan ishlash haqida suhbatlashmoqda. Savollar: kim uydan ishlashni yoqtiradi, qanday sabab keltiradi va ikkinchisi nimadan xavotirda? Bog‘lovchi so‘zlarni ham toping: “firstly”, “however”, “in conclusion”. Ular suhbatni tartibli qilmoqda.
scenes.say: Anna: I think working from home is better. Firstly, I save two hours a day because I don't commute. Tom: I see your point. However, I feel lonely at home. Anna: That's true, but I call my colleagues online. Tom: I agree up to a point. In conclusion, a mix of both is perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Menimcha, uydan ishlash yaxshiroq. Birinchidan, qatnamasligim uchun kuniga ikki soat tejayman. Tom: Fikringni tushundim. Biroq uyda o‘zimni yolg‘iz his qilaman. Anna: To‘g‘ri, lekin hamkasblarga onlayn qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Tom: Ma’lum darajada roziman. Xulosa qilib aytganda, ikkalasini aralash qilgan yaxshi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Anna nima uchun uyni afzal ko‘radi? Ikkinchi: Tomning muammosi nima? Uchinchi: Tomning xulosasi qanday? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering va imkon bo‘lsa, “because” ni ishlating. Dialogdagi aynan o‘sha iboralarni eslashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: One: Why does Anna prefer working from home? Two: What is Tom's problem? Three: What is Tom's conclusion?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Anna nima uchun uydan ishlashni afzal ko‘radi? Ikkinchi: Tomning muammosi nima? Uchinchi: Tomning xulosasi qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) She saves two hours because she doesn't commute.
3) A mix of both is perfect.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, Anna kuniga ikki soat tejaydi, chunki qatnamaydi. Ikkinchi, Tom uyda o‘zini yolg‘iz his qiladi. Uchinchi, Tomning xulosasi: uydan ham, ofisda ham ishlashni aralash qilgan yaxshi. Dialogda Anna qarshi fikrni tan oldi, “That’s true, but…”, Tom esa “I agree up to a point” dedi. Mana shu tabiiy, odobli munozara namunasi.
scenes.say: One: She saves two hours because she doesn't commute. Two: He feels lonely at home. Three: A mix of both is perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: U ikki soat tejaydi, chunki qatnamaydi. Ikkinchi: U uyda o‘zini yolg‘iz his qiladi. Uchinchi: Ikkalasini aralash qilgan mukammal.

scenes.title: Fikrni kengaytirish: bir nechta so‘z
board: The main benefit is… / The biggest problem is…

examples.t: The main benefit is that it saves time.
It depends on how you use it.

scenes.say_native: Fikringizni boyitish uchun yana uchta foydali qolip bor. “The main benefit is that…” va “The biggest problem is that…” orqali eng muhim afzallik yoki kamchilikni ajratib ko‘rsatasiz. Agar mavzu ikki yoqlama bo‘lsa, “It depends on…” deyish mumkin, ya’ni bu bog‘liq. Bu ojizlik emas, aksincha, o‘ylangan javob. O‘zbekchada “qanday ishlatishga bog‘liq” deymiz, inglizchada aynan shu ma’no “it depends on how you use it”.
scenes.say: The main benefit is that it saves time. The biggest problem is that it can be expensive. It depends on how you use it.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy foydasi shuki, vaqtni tejaydi. Eng katta muammo shuki, u qimmat bo‘lishi mumkin. Bu qanday foydalanishingizga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Tarjima qilingan iboralar
scenes.say_native: Yana bir keng tarqalgan xato: iborani o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilish. “Fikrimcha” ni “by my opinion” deyish noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “in my opinion”. Shuningdek “according to me” ham tabiiy emas, uning o‘rniga “from my point of view” yoki “I think” deng. “According to” boshqa odamning gapiga ishora qilganda to‘g‘ri: “according to the news”. Predloglar har tilda o‘ziga xos, shuning uchun iborani bir butun qolipda yodlang.
scenes.say: Say in my opinion, not by my opinion. Say from my point of view, not according to me. Learn each phrase as a whole.
scenes.say_uz: In my opinion deng, by my opinion emas. From my point of view deng, according to me emas. Har bir iborani butunligicha yodlang.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ohang va urg‘u
board: I THINK it's GOOD. (urg‘u ma’noli so‘zlarda)
scenes.say_native: Fikr bildirganda ohang ham muhim. Fikr aytilgan gapda ovoz oxirida pasayadi: “I think it’s good”. Savolda esa, masalan “Do you agree?”, ovoz ko‘tariladi. “I think” iborasidagi “I” va “think” ni odatda tez va kuchsiz aytamiz, urg‘uni ma’noli so‘zga beramiz: “I think it’s GOOD”. Yana bir maslahat: “however” va “firstly” dan keyin sal to‘xtang. Bu tinglovchiga fikringizni kuzatishga yordam beradi.
scenes.say: I think it's good. Falling voice at the end. Do you agree? Rising voice for a question. However, it is expensive. Pause after however.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, bu yaxshi. Oxirida ovoz pasayadi. Qo‘shilasizmi? Savolda ovoz ko‘tariladi. Biroq u qimmat. However dan keyin to‘xtang.

scenes.title: Ohang bilan ayting
board: 1) I think it's a great idea.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni mos ohang bilan ayting. Birinchi: fikr, oxirida ovoz pasayadi. Ikkinchi: savol, oxirida ko‘tariladi. Uchinchi: “however” dan keyin kichik pauza. Ikkinchi marta tezroq va tabiiyroq qiling. Ovozingiz xuddi suhbatdagidek jonli chiqsin, robotdek emas.
scenes.say: I think it's a great idea. Do you agree with me? However, it is expensive. Say them again, a little faster.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, bu zo‘r g‘oya. Menga qo‘shilasizmi? Biroq u qimmat. Yana bir marta, biroz tezroq ayting.

scenes.title: Tekshiruv
board: I think it's a great idea. ↘
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Birinchi gapda ovoz oxirida pasayishi kerak edi, chunki bu darak gap. Ikkinchi gapda “me” da ovoz ko‘tarildi, chunki bu ha-yo‘q savoli. Uchinchi gapda “however” dan keyin kichik pauza bo‘ldi. O‘zbek tilida savol ohangi ko‘pincha “-mi” qo‘shimchasida bo‘ladi, inglizchada esa asosan ohang va so‘z tartibi shuni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: The first sentence falls at the end. The question rises on me. After however, there is a short pause.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi gap oxirida ovoz pasayadi. Savolda me da ovoz ko‘tariladi. However dan keyin qisqa pauza bor.

scenes.title: Namuna: Ijtimoiy tarmoq foydalimi?
scenes.say_native: Endi bir daqiqalik nutq namunasini tinglang. Mavzu aynan uy vazifangiz: “Is social media useful?”. Ko‘ring, nutq qanday qurilgan: fikr, birinchi sabab, ikkinchi sabab, qarama-qarshi fikr va xulosa. Aynan shu tuzilmadan o‘zingiz foydalanasiz. Iboralarni qayd qiling: “In my opinion”, “Firstly”, “However”, “In conclusion”.
scenes.say: In my opinion, social media is useful. Firstly, it helps us stay in touch with friends abroad. Secondly, we can learn new things, for example from video lessons. However, it can waste time. In conclusion, it is useful if we use it wisely.
scenes.say_uz: Fikrimcha, ijtimoiy tarmoq foydali. Birinchidan, chet eldagi do‘stlar bilan aloqada bo‘lishga yordam beradi. Ikkinchidan, yangi narsalarni, masalan video darslardan o‘rganamiz. Biroq u vaqtni behuda ketkazishi mumkin. Xulosa qilib aytganda, aqlli foydalansak, u foydali.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: o‘z fikringiz
board: Topic: Should children use phones at school?
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Mavzu: bolalar maktabda telefon ishlatishi kerakmi? Fikringizni ayting, ikkita sabab keltiring, bitta misol qo‘shing, “however” bilan qarama-qarshi fikrni tilga oling va xulosa qiling. Taxminan yarim daqiqa gapiring. Iboralar doskada. Boshlang.
scenes.say: Should children use phones at school? Give your opinion, two reasons, an example, one however, and a conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Bolalar maktabda telefon ishlatishi kerakmi? Fikringiz, ikkita sabab, bitta misol, bitta however va xulosa keltiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I don't think phones should be allowed in lessons.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: “In my opinion, children should not use phones in lessons. Firstly, they can’t concentrate. Secondly, they might cheat in tests. For example, some students look up answers. However, phones can be useful in emergencies. In conclusion, I believe phones should be kept in bags during lessons.” Sizning fikringiz teskari bo‘lishi mumkin. Muhimi tuzilma: fikr, sabablar, misol, qarama-qarshilik va xulosa.
scenes.say: In my opinion, children should not use phones in lessons. Firstly, they can't concentrate. Secondly, they might cheat. However, phones can be useful in emergencies. In conclusion, phones should stay in bags.
scenes.say_uz: Fikrimcha, bolalar darsda telefon ishlatmasligi kerak. Birinchidan, diqqatini jamlay olmaydi. Ikkinchidan, ko‘chirishi mumkin. Biroq favqulodda holatda telefon foydali. Xulosa: telefonlar sumkada tursin.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Opinion: I think / In my opinion
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Fikr uchun: “I think”, “In my opinion”, “I believe”. Asoslash uchun: “because” va “for example”. Rozilik uchun: “I agree”, “I couldn’t agree more”. Odobli rad etish uchun: “I see what you mean, but” va “I’m afraid I don’t agree”. Bog‘lovchi so‘zlar: “firstly”, “moreover”, “however”, “in conclusion”. Eng muhim xatolarni eslang: “I am agree” va “but however” aytmaslik.
scenes.say: Let's review. Give your opinion, add a reason with because, and an example. Agree and disagree politely. Use linking words: firstly, moreover, however, in conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. Fikringizni ayting, because bilan sabab va misol qo‘shing. Odob bilan rozi bo‘ling yoki rad eting. Bog‘lovchi so‘zlarni ishlating: firstly, moreover, however, in conclusion.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: “Is social media useful?” mavzusida bir daqiqalik fikringizni ovoz chiqarib ayting, telefonga yozib oling va o‘zingiz tinglang. Mezon: fikr aniq, kamida ikkita sabab, bitta misol, “however” bilan bitta qarama-qarshi fikr va xulosa bor, taxminan bir daqiqa davom etadi. Keyingi darsda ishga kirish suhbatini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to give a one-minute opinion on: Is social media useful? Record yourself and check: opinion, reasons, example, however, conclusion. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: Ijtimoiy tarmoq foydalimi mavzusida bir daqiqalik fikr bildiring. O‘zingizni yozib oling va tekshiring: fikr, sabablar, misol, however, xulosa. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Is social media useful? mavzusida bir daqiqalik fikringizni ovoz chiqarib ayting va yozib oling. Mezon: aniq fikr, kamida 2 ta sabab (because), 1 ta misol (for example), however bilan 1 ta qarama-qarshi fikr va in conclusion bilan xulosa bor; nutq taxminan 1 daqiqa davom etadi.

quiz.why_uz: Agree — fe’l, uning oldidan am kerak emas.

quiz.q: I like trains ___ they are cheap.
quiz.why_uz: Because dan keyin to‘liq gap (they are cheap) keladi.

quiz.q: We stayed at home ___ the rain.
quiz.why_uz: Because of dan keyin ot (the rain) keladi.

quiz.q: Which is the most polite way to disagree?
quiz.why_uz: I'm afraid I don't agree — yumshoq va to‘g‘ri.

options: Although it is old, but I like it.
Although it is old, I like it.
But although it is old I like.
Although old but I like it.
quiz.why_uz: Although va but bir gapda birga ishlatilmaydi.

quiz.q: It is cheap. ___, it isn't very strong.
Which word adds another similar point?
What do you think ___ working from home?
quiz.why_uz: What do you think about… — to‘g‘ri predlog about.

quiz.q: Which sentence ends the speech best?
options: In conclusion, social media is useful if we use it wisely.
